about.text: I'm a Full Stack developer specialized in Java - Spring Boot, with experience in AWS cloud technologies (SQS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Lambdas), as well as Git, Docker and Kubernetes. I have frontend experience in Angular and Next.js, REST and SOAP service integration, and I've worked on both legacy and modern systems. I focus on building scalable, efficient and maintainable solutions.

projects.intro: Projects built from start to finish, several born from real use cases, with different technologies and approaches, from web applications to automation solutions.

autofacsigo.description: Full-stack platform for a chemicals distributor: public catalog with shopping cart, admin dashboard with charts, and automatic Siigo invoice capture with Selenium. JWT authentication with roles. Deployed with Docker.

forogood.description: Dynamic online forum with user registration, validations and JWT authentication with Spring Security. REST API built with Spring Boot, Lombok and JPA on MySQL, consumed by an Angular front end.

bookstore.description: Online bookstore with Spring Boot and Angular: JWT authentication with Spring Security, PayPal API payments, validations, error handling, book purchases and file downloads.

moviestream.description: TV series app that consumes an external API. Spring Boot REST API that automates data handling, with an Angular and Tailwind front end.

jobboard.description: Job board where companies post vacancies and students apply. Sign-up, login, password recovery, validations and error handling. PHP with MVC pattern, PostgreSQL and Sass.

doblin.description: Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that dubs English video courses into Spanish. It reads the subtitles, joins them into complete sentences and translates them with an AI model that runs in your own browser (Transformers.js and ONNX Runtime), then narrates them with synchronized voice. No paid APIs and no data sent to any server. Built with TypeScript, Vite and tested with Vitest.

ginko.title: Full-Stack Developer
ginko.description: A fintech banking platform: cloud-native, highly available and in production for several banks. I take part in the full cycle: analysis, development, testing and deployment through CI/CD pipelines.
points: Microservices and workers in Java 17/21 and Spring Boot 3, with SQS queues, Dead Letter Queues and DynamoDB.
Migration of more than 12 microservices to AWS Secrets Manager and Parameter Store, with a naming convention and fail-fast behavior.
Design of a solution with S3, CloudFront and Parameter Store to update browser monitoring (New Relic) without redeploying.
Frontend in Next.js 14 and TypeScript: Google Analytics 4, CSRF vulnerability fixes and a Docker image 1.1 GB lighter.
Quality: testing with JUnit 5 and Mockito, SonarQube reviews across 19 artifacts and ReDoS vulnerability fixes.
Delivery: GitLab CI/CD pipelines and hotfixes with cherry-picks coordinated across release branches.
Applied AI: custom Claude Code workflows for estimation, bug analysis and documentation.
During a period without a technical lead I coordinated the team: delivery estimation, releases, documentation and client meetings.
